steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: Stop right there, Kal'tsit.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: You're back.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: So, did you think things through, or...?

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: You wanted this, right? Take it.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: You acted unilaterally, without permission.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: I do not interfere in the private affairs of our operators, nor do I ask them what they did in their free time - as long as they do not tarnish Rhodes Island's reputation.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: I hope that whatever you did does not cost you your position in Rhodes Island, Skadi.

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: I'm not here for your snide remarks. I'm well aware of the rules. You needed something from me, and I need something from you.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: What do you want from me then?

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: Information.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Do you consider the information I have to be worth as little as this key?

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: I can crush this stone in my palm in a heartbeat. I'm sure you don't want that.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: What I do know is that you went to Dewville in Kazimierz under pretenses of being on a mission, and even got into a conflict with a fellow operator.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: She kept quiet about what happened both there and at Rhodes Island for your sake. But in fact, I never assigned any such mission to you.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Hmm? The core has already been filled with blood. This is not your blood. You wouldn't dare shed your own blood onto this soil.

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: It's Grani's blood.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: You've already done something like this...

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: I'll repay her. You don't need to remind me.

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: I know this is what you need. A key, a core, a memory block... whatever it might be. I just have to obtain it.

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: 'Skull,' 'Flamelung,' 'Yellow Smog'... I took them all out.

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: Otherwise, they surely would have taken this item. You wouldn't be able to barter with them, because you can't give them what they want.

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: You need this 'stone,' and I need the information you have.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: What a farce. I don't need any of these... components... to form the full picture.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: You're bound to Rhodes Island by contract, and you're bound to me likewise.

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: You give me what I need, and I give you what you need.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: I rarely see you this aggressive. Where's your usual laziness and snark?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: You want to know where Spectre's Originium nerve agent came from.

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: ...How'd you find out?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: (Ægirian) 'Abyssal Hunters are bound by blood.'

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: There's nothing I don't know.

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: ...Give me the info.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Very well. As long as you follow my every order, I might even decide to help you. The condition is, as long as you follow my every order.

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: I only follow those who are trustworthy.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: I never go back on my word.
